purpose: Behavioral evaluation requests and rubrics. These cases require actual agent runs; their presence is not evidence of passing behavior.

messages: I need to finish a thesis proposal in six weeks. I only know that I want to study AI and learning.
University students, survey access, and I haven't started reading yet.
rubric: Ask no more than three material questions per turn
Draft the spec and unknowns within two substantive answer turns
Never invent university rules
Offer an exploratory next action linked to a milestone

messages: I'm moving in a month and I only have 10 minutes today. Help me start.
I missed the session. Can we make the next step smaller?
rubric: Use everyday language without coding ceremonies
Connect the small action to moving preparation
Treat duration as an estimate
Offer a smaller useful result without guilt

messages: Two of three research questions are drafted.
rubric: Partial result remains in progress
Identify the actual current action or ask one clarification
Do not auto-complete parent outcomes

messages: I can't access the data yet.
My supervisor wants to narrow the topic to first-year students.
rubric: Record the blocker and offer unblocking work
Propose affected spec/milestone changes
Preserve the hard deadline and artifacts
Save material revisions only after user acceptance
With no writable Notion tools, label the proposal unsaved
Do not invent a successful save
Continue useful project conversation
Establish timezone and requested intent
Use actual scheduler tools only when authorized
Retain schedule identity across partial setup
Confirm actual disabled state before claiming shutdown
cases.allowed_effects: Mock tool results only; live activation needs user opt-in

messages: Continue this project from its Notion link.
rubric: Reload current authoritative state
Retain manual edits
Surface same-field conflicts
Do not ask the user to repeat accessible project facts

messages: The last check-in may already have been sent.
I missed a week and added lots of smaller steps.
rubric: Reconcile uncertain delivery instead of resending
Offer one current recovery step
Do not claim completion from time or fabricate a percentage
Reject invalid hierarchy/dependency relationships
